import random
random.seed(3)
# verify: (i) run length = v2(x+1)-1 exactly; (ii) depth decreases by exactly 1 along runs
def v2(n):
    c=0
    while n%2==0: n//=2; c+=1
    return c
ok=tot=0; okdec=0; totdec=0
for _ in range(20000):
    x=random.randrange(10**12,10**13)*2+1
    g=v2(x+1)
    # measure actual run of b=1 from x
    k=0; y=x
    while True:
        z=3*y+1; b=v2(z)
        if b!=1: break
        yy=z//2
        if v2(yy+1)!=v2(y+1)-1 if v2(y+1)>1 else False: pass
        totdec+=1
        okdec+= (v2(yy+1)==v2(y+1)-1)
        y=yy; k+=1
    tot+=1; ok+= (k==g-1)
print(f"run length == v2(x+1)-1: {ok}/{tot}")
print(f"depth decreases by exactly 1 per run step: {okdec}/{totdec}")
